tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and app window background. A cool off-white leaning toward the ink; in dark, a night navy near black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: One tone step off the ground: the app's sidebar and file queue, a footer tile, the light half of a split section. Surfaces are told apart by this step, not by a rule or a shadow.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Two steps off the ground: code blocks, the drop zone at rest, the empty track of a progress bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text, headings, transcript text and figures, on ground, surface and sunk (12:1 or more in both themes). Night navy, never black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text only: timestamps in a transcript, file sizes and durations, provenance lines, legal text. On ground, surface and sunk (5.7:1 or more in both themes). Never for transcript text.

tokens.name: plume
tokens.usage: The accent: a sky-blue budgie's plumage. The primary button, the hero stage behind the transcript panel, a progress bar's fill and the played part of a waveform. At most one plume object per screen besides the stage and progress. Never text on ground.

tokens.name: plume-press
tokens.usage: Hovered and pressed fill of a plume button; the drop zone's fill while a file is dragged over it.

tokens.name: on-plume
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a plume or plume-press fill, in both themes (7.5:1 or more). Never white.

tokens.name: beak
tokens.usage: The square in the wordmark, the playhead, and the token being decoded right now. A mark, never text or a fill bigger than the wordmark square (3.9:1 on light ground, 8.6:1 on dark).

tokens.name: term
tokens.usage: The dark field of the transcript panel on the site's stage and of the waveform strip. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Transcript text and commands on term (14:1 light, 17:1 dark).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Timestamps, the stats line under a run and unselected control borders, on term (6.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: The 1px edge between a panel's title row and its body. Decorative, inside data-ui only.

tokens.name: wave
tokens.usage: Unplayed waveform bars and token-duration blocks on term (3.5:1 on term).

tokens.name: wave-played
tokens.usage: Waveform bars and duration blocks behind the playhead. An alias of plume.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: A finished file or a passing check, always beside the word Done or ok. On ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: A file that failed, always beside the reason ("No audio track in this file"). On ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset (2px inside the app). Ink in light, plume in dark; 9:1 or more on the ground either way.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text: ink, underlined 1px at 0.2em offset; 2px on hover.

families.mono: "Commit Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one number a section or screen is about: a file's length, a run's elapsed time. clamp(88px, 10vw, 168px) on the site; 64px in the app. Tabular figures. Once per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero h1 and a split heading on the site. clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px); 10vw on a phone. Two lines at most, sentence case. Not used in the app.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Speech to text in one small C11 library.
styles.usage: Section headings (h2) on the site; the empty-state line in the app. 22px on a phone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: pktito pulls the audio out of an mp3 or mp4 with the media libraries your OS already has, then transcribes it on the CPU.
styles.usage: Running text on the site, 45–75 characters a line. 17px on a phone.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: So the plan is to ship the desktop build first and keep the library small enough to read in a weekend.
styles.usage: Transcript text in the app and on the stage. Looser leading than body so a long transcript can be read for minutes.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The first paragraph of an intro and inline emphasis. Never bold 700 in running text.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: App buttons, file names in the queue, menu items. The app's working size.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Status lines, nav links on the site, legal text. The floor: nothing is set smaller than 13px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and terminal output. Commit Mono only sets real code, commands, output, file names, flags and timestamps.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Timestamps beside transcript segments, durations in the file queue, provenance under a measurement. Tabular by nature; always hh:mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.cc.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; progress bar to its status line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a toolbar; between queue rows; figure to its unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside an app pane and a queue row; timestamp column to transcript text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside the transcript panel and a code block; between transcript segments.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Headline to its supporting sentence; the drop zone's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The transcript panel's inset from the stage's top and left edges.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between the parts of a how-it-works column on the site.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on the site; 96px on a phone. Always more than any gap inside a section.

tokens.name: margin-page
tokens.usage: The site's outer margins at desktop; 20px on a phone (16px plus the safe-area inset at least).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything on the site: buttons, the stage, tiles, images. Waveform bars and duration blocks everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-ui
tokens.usage: Inside the app and inside a data-ui fragment on the site: buttons, the drop zone, queue rows, the transcript panel. Matches the corners macOS and Windows 11 draw on their own controls.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Progress bar tracks and the status dot, nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only what truly floats: an open menu, a dialog, the app window in a site screenshot. Nothing at rest has a shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Width of running text, about 65 characters of body.

tokens.name: column-narrow
tokens.usage: The transcript column in the app at its widest; code blocks on the site.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: One encoder frame (80 ms of audio) on any drawn timeline. Duration blocks are a whole number of frames wide; waveform bars sit one frame apart. The only ornament in the system.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the app's file queue pane. The transcript takes the rest.

tokens.name: window-min
tokens.usage: The app window's minimum width (tauri.conf.json minWidth); below 880px the queue collapses to a strip above the transcript.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Widest the site's grid gets; full-bleed fields still run to the viewport edge.
